item.title: Verbose beta 252
item.description:
A welcome tour that shows the way in

Mac

  • The welcome tour shows four more ways in: Record, Import, New thought, and Search or ask. Each one shows its shortcut. Everyone sees the new tour once; open it again from Settings.

Also on iPhone

  • The welcome tour shows the ways to record and how to add the Verbose keyboard.
